title: Replace ADO with Entity Framework in C#
problem_statement: ADO is outdated and poses security and maintainability issues.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued use of insecure and unsupported data access technology.
suggested_approach: Refactor data access code to use Entity Framework.
success_criteria: All data access operations are performed using Entity Framework.
No references to ADO remain in the codebase.
